links.outcome: Patient outcomes and workflow metrics before vs after RapidAI implementation, adjusted analyses
links.effect: No significant adjusted differences in IVT (aOR 0.93), MT (aOR 2.73), discharge mRS 0-1 (aOR 1.47); decompressive craniectomy lower (aOR 0.15) and LOS reduced (B -2.33 days).
links.quote: Rescue decompressive craniectomy was lower in the post period (adjusted OR 0.15; 95% CI 0.03-0.82; p = 0.029) and hospital length of stay was reduced (adjusted B -2.33 days; 95% CI -3.62 to -1.03; p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world clinical and workflow impact of implementing RapidAI perfusion software before and after institutional deployment, but does not compare specific deployment practices or safeguards.
